## Building `vegan`-Ready Community Matrices

`vpro_matrix()` converts scoped `VP08` vegetation data directly into a dense `matrix` (or sparse `Matrix::dgCMatrix`) with literal `PlotNumber` row names and a 1-to-1 row-aligned `attr(mat, "env")` tibble:

```{r}
library(vpro)

con <- vpro_sample()
mat <- vpro_matrix(
  con,
  value = "cover",
  strata = "total",
  lump = TRUE,
  transform = "sqrt",
  drop_rare = 2,
  exclude_modifiers = TRUE
)
dim(mat)
mat[1:5, 1:6]
```

Because `attr(mat, "env")` is aligned row-for-row with `rownames(mat)`, `vegan` ordination and PERMANOVA pipelines work without manual join boilerplate:

```{r}
if (requireNamespace("vegan", quietly = TRUE)) {
  env_aligned <- attr(mat, "env")
  dist_bray <- vegan::vegdist(mat, method = "bray")
  perm <- vegan::adonis2(dist_bray ~ Elevation, data = env_aligned, permutations = 99, na.action = na.omit)
  print(perm)
}
```

## Fuzzy Noise Clustering (`vegclust`) and Indicator Species

BEC classification workflows frequently use fuzzy noise clustering (`method = "vegclust_nc"`) so transitional or disturbed plots are isolated in a noise class rather than distorting core site-series centroids:

```{r}
cl <- vpro_cluster(
  con,
  method = "vegclust_nc",
  transform = "sqrt",
  k = 4,
  m = 1.25,
  dnoise = 0.75,
  unit_prefix = "CL"
)
cl$summary
head(cl$memberships)
```

Compute indicator species fidelity and specificity across the resulting candidate clusters with `vpro_indicators()`:

```{r}
ind <- vpro_indicators(con, clusters = cl, permutations = 49)
head(ind, 10)
```

## Atomic Round-Trip Write-Back to `VPro` (`vpro_wails`)

Once candidate clusters are reviewed in R, `vpro_write_candidate_su()` writes `<Name>_ClusterCandidate_SU` atomically (`BEGIN IMMEDIATE`) with `_table_metadata ('VP04')`, `<Project>_Audit`, and `__VPRO_RSidecarHistory` provenance so the candidate classification appears immediately in `vpro_wails`:

```{r}
# Demonstrate on a disposable WAL copy of Sample.db
work_db <- tempfile("sample-roundtrip-", fileext = ".db")
file.copy(con$project_path, work_db)

ws_work <- vpro_connect(work_db)
ws_cand <- vpro_write_candidate_su(ws_work, cl, name = "Sample_Noise4")
vpro_list_su(ws_cand)

unlink(c(work_db, paste0(work_db, "-wal"), paste0(work_db, "-shm")))
```
